policies.title: Kenyan and Djiboutian ordinary passports: Ethiopia visa-free tourist entry
policies.summary: The live official eVisa arrival page expressly says Kenyan and Djiboutian citizens holding a valid passport can enter Ethiopia without a visa. This narrower express exemption takes precedence over those codes also appearing in the mutable arrival table.
conditions: The page requires a valid passport. It does not state a stay limit, entry count, operating port, fee, onward-ticket, funds, accommodation, vaccination or extension rule for this exemption.

This finding is limited to the named ordinary-passport visitor nationality rule. It does not decide African Union, diplomatic, official, service, residence, work, business, transit, Ethiopian-origin card, refugee, special-document or individual-admissibility treatment.
Border admission remains subject to immigration and security examination; the current eVisa general guidance reserves officials' right to deny entry.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Ethiopia tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current official eVisa service renders this exhaustive named tourist cohort with the category Visa on Arrival. The portal separately offers an online tourist visa, but an express arrival route is the easier baseline and is normalized as visa_on_arrival.
conditions: This is the official portal's current named tourist Visa-on-Arrival schedule. It does not state a universal visa-on-arrival duration, fee, passport-validity, onward-ticket, funds, accommodation, vaccination, extension, transit or work rule.

The live direct source does not identify the operating port or expressly confirm Addis Ababa Bole Airport. Accordingly this candidate records a route-limited arrival authorization but does not generalize it to every Ethiopian border or airport.

The current eVisa general information says entry officers may deny admission. Residence, business, employment, conference, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service, Ethiopian-origin and other special-document routes are outside this baseline.

policies.title: Other ordinary passports: Ethiopia electronic single-entry tourist visa
policies.summary: The official Tourist Visa page expressly makes citizens of all countries eligible and calls the visitor authorization an electronic single-entry visa. The named visa-free and visa-on-arrival cohorts are removed because they have an easier direct route; the remaining ordinary passports are therefore evisa, not an inferred consular-visa complement.
conditions: This is tourism or other non-business travel only. It is electronic and single-entry; the official page lists 30-day and 90-day maximum-duration products, and says normal processing is three days with application at least three days before expected arrival.

A recent passport photo and a passport valid at least six months from intended entry are stated requirements. The official guidance gives fees of USD 62 for 30 days and USD 152 for 90 days, with later extension procedures and overstay penalties.

The portal's global eligibility statement is explicit. Separately, it says it does not accept credit-card transactions from AF, CU, IQ, SD, SY and YE (as well as three codes already covered by the easier arrival schedule). This is retained as a material payment/access condition rather than silently reclassifying the passports as advance-visa or unresolved.

The portal says entry may be refused even to an eVisa holder. This baseline does not decide business, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, Ethiopian-origin, refugee, special-document, health or case-specific security/admissibility rules.

application.label: Ethiopian Government eVisa service
application.processingTime: The Tourist Visa page states normal processing is three days and advises applying at least three days before estimated arrival.
steps: Use the Ethiopian Government eVisa service and choose the tourist visa for tourism or other non-business travel.
Provide the required recent photo and passport that is valid at least six months from intended entry, then complete the portal's payment and application process.
Obtain approval before travel and present the approved eVisa and travel documents for immigration examination at entry.

policies.title: Ethiopian citizens: constitutional right to return
policies.summary: The Constitution directly grants Ethiopian nationals the right to return to Ethiopia, so the same-country ordinary-passport pair is not classified under the foreign tourist visa system.
conditions: This records the constitutional citizen return right only. It does not decide passport issuance or validity, dual nationality, document checks, health, customs, criminal process, security screening or other border formalities.
